label: corpusculum
definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that is a hard, dark, clip-like body secreted by the style head of the gynostegium (FLOPO:0986051) between two adjacent anthers, which, together with two translator arms, joins pollinia (FLOPO:0986016) of adjacent anthers into a pollinarium and clips it to a pollinator, as in Apocynaceae subfamily Asclepiadoideae.
reason: The corpusculum is a hardened secretion, not tissue, so 'multi-tissue plant structure' is the wrong genus. Use the same parent as pollinium (PO:0009011). The definition is not in genus-differentia form, and 'stigma head' should be 'style head' to match FLOPO's style head class. The synonyms are fine; it is correctly kept distinct from the orchid viscidium.

label: pedicel scar
reason: Correct genus-differentia definition, consistent with leaf scar (FLOPO:0986052, a cardinal organ part that is part of a shoot axis).

label: elater
definition: A plant cell (PO:0009002) of a liverwort sporangium (PO:0025094) that is elongated, dead at maturity and has spiral wall thickenings, lies among the spores and twists as its moisture content changes, so helping to loosen and disperse the spores.
reason: Not in genus-differentia form. Including hornworts is wrong: hornworts have pseudo-elaters, which are often multicellular and lack spiral thickenings. The definition should also be kept separate from the Equisetum 'elaters', which are ribbon-like bands of the spore wall, not cells, so that annotations of horsetail spores do not map here.

label: faucal appendage
definition: A multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025496) that is an infolding or scale-like outgrowth of the corolla (PO:0009059) in the corolla throat, opposite a corolla lobe, that partly closes the mouth of the corolla tube, as in Boraginaceae.
reason: The class is sound but the exact synonym 'corolla appendage' is far too wide: it also covers coronas, spurs and lobe appendages, and would capture unrelated text. Move it out (at most related). The definition is also not in genus-differentia form. Part_of could be the FLOPO corolla throat class rather than the whole corolla.

label: stipule scar
reason: Correct and well formed, parallel to leaf scar. 'cicatrice stipulaire' is a French exact synonym and belongs in the French synonym column.

label: stereid band
reason: Matches bryological usage: bands of stereids dorsal and/or ventral to the guide cells in the costa. Genus-differentia form, cites PO stereid.

label: pseudoperianth
reason: Correct: a post-fertilization sheath of thallus tissue (Marchantia, also Fossombronia), correctly kept apart from the gametophyte perianth (PO:0030031). A narrower genus (multi-tissue plant structure) would also be defensible.

label: asexual propagule
definition: A plant structure (PO:0009011) that becomes detached from the parent plant and grows into a new individual without sexual reproduction, such as a gemma (PO:0025614), a bulbil, a brood body, a rhizoidal tuber or a deciduous branchlet.
reason: 'Brood body' is a kind of asexual propagule, not the same thing, so it should not be an exact synonym (it would make PO gemma and brood cells collide with this class). The definition lacks the parent ID. PO gemma (PO:0025614), and FLOPO bulbil and turion, are natural subclasses. The related synonym 'propagule' is also a PO synonym of fruit, so keep it related only.

label: floret callus
reason: Standard grass usage (base of the lemma plus a rachilla segment, the point where the floret breaks away). Well formed. Keeping 'callus' as a related synonym only is right, since PO 'plant callus' is tissue culture.

label: chlorophyllose cell
definition: A plant cell (PO:0009002) of a non-vascular leaf (PO:0025075) that is narrow, living and contains chloroplasts and lies between large dead hyaline cells (FLOPO:0986077), forming a network in Sphagnum or a layer between layers of hyaline cells in Leucobryaceae.
reason: Too narrow: Leucobryum and its relatives also have chlorophyllose cells (chlorocysts) between hyaline cells. 'Its cross-sectional shape ... are diagnostic' is a usage note, not part of a definition. Its partner class, hyaline cell, sits under native plant cell (PO:0025606); one of the two parents should be aligned.

label: clinandrium
reason: The definition is correct and well formed (anther bed at the column apex). However, the exact synonym 'clinandrium-hood' names only the raised margin of the clinandrium, not the whole cavity, so it should be removed or made related. 'anther bed' and 'androclinium' are fine.

label: dorsal lamina
reason: Correct Fissidens usage: the dorsal lamina lies on the abaxial side of the costa, opposite the vaginant laminae (FLOPO:0986095). Genus-differentia form.

label: endocarp condyle
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of an endocarp (PO:0009086) that is an intrusion of the endocarp into the locule, around which the seed is curved, and that is often hollow or perforate, as in Menispermaceae.
reason: The meaning is right (Menispermaceae condyle) but the text lacks the genus and PO identifiers.

label: endostome basal membrane
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of an endostome (FLOPO:0986064) that is its continuous, membranous lower part, from which the endostome segments and cilia arise, in the peristome (PO:0030042) of a moss capsule.
reason: The meaning is right, but FLOPO already has endostome (FLOPO:0986064), so part_of should point to it rather than to the whole peristome, and the definition should cite it. Also, curation/flopo-trait-phenotype-classification.tsv lists FLOPO_0986125 with the label 'endostome'; check that this is not a mapping error.

label: phyllid lamella
reason: Correct (Polytrichaceae, Pterygoneurum and other Pottiaceae). Genus-differentia form with PO identifiers.

label: nodal diaphragm
reason: The definition is good. However, bare 'diaphragm' as an exact synonym would also capture the diaphragmed (chambered) pith of Juglans and similar stems and the transverse septa of Juncus leaves, which are not nodal. Move 'diaphragm' to related synonyms.

label: leaf vein axil
reason: Matches glossary usage (vein axils bearing hairs or domatia) and is well formed. Treating it as a region of the lamina, not a PO anatomical space (PO:0025224 axil, which is shoot–leaf), is appropriate.

label: cirrus
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a leaf rachis (PO:0020055) that is its long, leafless, whip-like, non-coiling extension beyond the uppermost leaflets, armed with grapnel-like spines, by which climbing palms (rattans) attach to supports.
reason: The cirrus is the end part of the rachis, not a kind of rachis: a leaf has one rachis, which includes the cirrus. It should be a cardinal organ part that is part of the leaf rachis, like the other 'part of' classes. The meaning is right and correctly kept distinct from the flagellum, which is a modified inflorescence.

label: syconium
reason: The definition is correct and well formed. A note for consistency: syconium ostiole (FLOPO:0986063) is part of capitulum inflorescence (PO:0030121), and PO lists 'hypanthodium' as a capitulum synonym. The ostiole should now be part of this class.

label: anther theca appendage
reason: Correct (Acanthaceae theca spurs and tails), well formed, and distinct from connective appendage.

label: carpopodium
definition: A cardinal organ part (PO:0025001) of a cypsela (FLOPO:0986053) that is a distinct ring or pad of differentiated, often sclerified cells at its base, by which the fruit is attached to the receptacle and from which it separates.
reason: The meaning is right (Asteraceae carpopodium) but the text lacks the PO and FLOPO identifiers. 'basal callus' is better as a related synonym than an exact one.

label: floral spur
definition: A multi-tissue plant structure (PO:0025496) of a flower (PO:0009046) that is a hollow, tubular or sac-like extension of a petal, sepal, labellum or corolla, often containing nectar.
reason: PO already has petal spur (PO:0025511, a cardinal organ part) and corolla spur (PO:0025512, a collective organ part structure). As an umbrella class this must sit high enough to take both as subclasses; under cardinal organ part it cannot contain corolla spur.

label: velum
reason: Correct Isoetes usage and well formed.

label: teniola
definition: A portion of plant tissue (PO:0009007) of a non-vascular leaf (PO:0025075) that is a longitudinal band of elongate, thick-walled, often hyaline cells within the leaf lamina, between the costa (PO:0030072) and the margin, as in Calymperaceae.
reason: The meaning is right but the text lacks the identifiers and genus-differentia form, and puts the taxon in the middle of the definition rather than as an example.

label: tegula
reason: The definition is correct (Dressler's tegula: a stipe from the epidermis of the rostellum). However, the exact synonym 'stipe of pollinarium' is wider: the hamulus is the other kind of orchid stipe. It should be removed or made related. 'tegular stipe' is fine.
